purpose: Rights register for the clean-room AIAssistent1 assistant SFT v12 dataset.

review.decision_evidence: Direct rights-holder authorization in the Codex task on 2026-09-06 confirms that V12 belongs to the project, contains no real personal data, and is permitted for model training and derivative-weight distribution. The authorization also approves the meaning hour minus N minutes equals 60 minus N and the exact volume of 255 manually authored examples. Earlier sources retain the verified authorization recorded by the V11 register. The dataset generator was not run. prepare_dataset.py only assembled approved sources into the exact V12 artifacts.
